excerpt.zh: 我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]成功捕获了第一批野生太空兽群，我们相信只要投入足够的科学资金，就可以克隆出更多这样的生物。
excerpt.en: With our first successful capture of wild Space Fauna in [from.solar_system.GetName], we believe it possible to clone more of these creatures with the proper scientific investment.
